description: The stored state: connection, project, latest check, run, secrets, pull request and deploy. refresh re-reads the checkout, the pull request, the variables and the deployments.

refresh.description: Re-read the checkout, the pull request, the variables and the deployments first.

oneOf.description: The turn ended on a wake the agent armed (an observer that notifies its chat, unfired and unexpired): it waits on an event, not on the person.

AgentState.description: What the agent is doing for a hand-off, as the worker sees it. Descriptions only: no message body, tool input or result is ever copied here.

current.description: The last call's description, plain text, at most 120 characters.

kind.description: What the hand-off is for, so the page can place its row.

note.description: One plain line from the agent about what it is doing, at most 120 characters.

question.description: The open question's text, when the agent waits for an answer.

steps.description: Function calls the session has made.

waiting_for.description: What the agent waits for when `state` is `waiting` ("the run here to end").

working_on.description: Ids of the newest check's problems the agent is working on now (the page shows a spinner on them). Cleared when they leave a newer check or the hand-off ends.

BranchRef.description: A branch `project::use {from: checkout, source: name}` can take.

ahead.description: Commits the selected environment's branch (`origin/<branch>`) does not have; null when that branch is not on origin.

is_env_branch.description: The selected environment deploys this branch.

name.description: `main`, or `origin/feature-x` for a branch only on origin.

release_command.description: The release command from the manifest, when the failure is the release's.

base.description: The environment branch's head when checked.

commits.description: The commits of `base..commit`, newest first, at most 50. Empty when the base was not read or the commit is not on this machine.

handoff_id.description: The hand-off whose agent asked for it; null for the page's own checks.

manifest.description: The compose file it was checked with, from the repository root. When it is not the environment's, deploying this check switches the environment to it.

problems.description: Cloud plan first, then the checks here.

CheckSummary.description: A check in short, for the page's history (`Status.checks`); the whole record is `iii-cloud::check::get {id}`.

duration_ms.description: The plan and the checks here; a run's time is in its stages.

problems.description: The problems someone acts on (owner `agent` or `person`).

branches.description: Local branches and origin's, newest commit first, at most 30; a local branch hides its origin twin. Read on refresh, from the refs as they are.

not_served.description: The checkout's commits the selected environment does not serve (`<served>..HEAD`, newest first, at most 50), read on refresh. Null when nothing is served yet or the served commit could not be fetched.

created_at.description: When the project was made (for choosing between several).

last_deployment_at.description: Its newest deployment, when more than one project uses the repository.

CloudProjectInfo.description: A cloud project of the repository, for the page's project and environment selectors.

check_id.description: The check this worker deployed (`deploy {check_id}`); null for a deployment made elsewhere.

failure.description: For a failed deploy: what failed, in plain words, with the failing stage's log.

from_console.description: This worker did not create it: made in the console (the cloud's `type` is `manual` for both).

replaced_by.description: The deployment that replaced this one, when it is `replaced`.

DeployFailure.description: A failed deploy in plain words (spec: readable failures).

log_tail.description: The last ~40 lines of the failing stage's log, oldest first, redacted.

release_command.description: The release command from the manifest, for a release failure.

silent.description: The log shows an exit status but no error text.

title.description: Plain, per code: "The release command failed: `pnpm migrate`".

head.description: Its branch's head on origin, read on refresh. Null before the first refresh, or when origin did not answer or has no such branch.

HandoffBrief.description: Everything the agent needs for a hand-off, so the prompt can be one plain sentence plus the marker. No secret value is in it.

agent_problems.description: The problems that are the agent's to fix.

base.description: The base branch and its sha when the worktree was made: reset to it to start again (`OLD_ATTEMPT_COMMITS`).

checkout_path.description: The person's own checkout: do not touch it.

manifest.description: The compose file checked and deployed, relative to the worktree: the hand-off's, else the environment's.

other_compose_files.description: Other compose files tracked in the worktree that declare `containers:` (at most 10). They are not checked or deployed.

person_problems.description: The ones the person decides: bring each with a recommendation.

pushes_directly.description: The environment tracks its own branch: no pull request. Push only your fix branch; the person's deploy pushes the checked commit to the environment's branch.

remote_branch_note.description: One line when an earlier try left the fix branch on origin: the first push replaces it with `--force-with-lease`.

oneOf.description: The project is not in iii cloud yet.

has_cloud_block.description: The file on this machine has a `cloud:` section.

workers.description: Its containers, as the file on this machine says (else as iii cloud lists them); null when neither knows.

OtherCloudProject.description: A live cloud project of the person's teams that deploys another repository: it can't be used with this folder.

OverrideChoice.description: Which value of a console override the person keeps.

oneOf.description: The file's value wins at deploy (what the deploy does already).
The console's value is kept, which takes a change to the file.

at_least.description: The plan stops at its first blocking step: more may follow.

summary.description: What the plan runs: its workers and machine groups. Null without a plan.

groups.description: The groups' names, in the plan's order.

id.description: sha1(source, code, file, line), stable across checks.

skipped.description: The person skipped its name for now (`values::skip`). `EMPTY_DEFAULT_VARIABLE` then has severity `info`; `SECRET_MISSING` stays `block`.

cloud_projects.description: Every cloud project that uses this repository, across the person's teams, with its environments. The chosen one is `cloud_project`; `project::use {cloud_project_id}` picks another.

fell_back_from.description: Only in `project::use`'s answer: the `environment_id` asked for, which the cloud project no longer lists, so its default environment was taken.

other_cloud_projects.description: Live projects of the person's teams that deploy another repository.

RecentProject.description: A project the person used before, to switch back with `project::use {path, cloud_project_id, environment_id, mode}` (no `resolve` needed first).

path.description: The repository's root on this machine.

reused.description: A passed run of an earlier check answered this one: nothing ran again.

waiting_on.description: The workers stage has gone a minute with no new worker: who it waits for. The run is still `running`; null otherwise.

RunningDeploy.description: A deploy still moving, with where it was made from. A field is null when the worker never knew it.

path.description: The local folder it was made from: `project::use {path}` goes back to it.

external.description: Asked for a database URL the person chose to keep outside iii cloud.

target.description: Where the value goes: the team, worktree and environment the request was asked for, whatever the page has selected when the value is saved.

containers.description: The containers that have not connected.

from_head.description: The last commit the worktree took from the person's checkout (`from: checkout`): commits after it are the agent's. Null for a worktree made from the environment's branch.

source.description: The branch `use {from: checkout, source}` took; null: the checkout's HEAD.

source_sha.description: The commit `source` (else the checkout's HEAD) pointed at when the worktree was prepared: "moved since" compares the source's tip with it.

agent.description: The agent's work on the selected environment's open hand-off.

auto_fix.description: The worker's `auto_fix` setting: a person's check hands the agent its problems.

candidate.description: A folder `project::resolve` read while another project is selected: Setup's add-project steps show it. `project::use` selects it and clears this.

checks.description: Every kept check in short, of every environment, newest first (the latest 20, and the ones a merge, hand-off, pull request or deploy points at).

compose_files.description: The worktree's tracked compose files that declare `containers:`, for the page's app file picker. `choosable` is false for a file iii cloud can't plan by its name (`issue`: `NOT_WORKER_COMPOSE`).

handoff_brief.description: What the agent needs for the open hand-off, in one place.

override_choices.description: The person's choice per console override of the selected environment (`override::choose`), by setting: only choices made for the newest check's console and file values.

problems.description: What is wrong with the selection itself: `PROJECT_DELETED`, `ENVIRONMENT_DELETED`.

recent_projects.description: Projects used before, newest first: not the current one, nor a folder that is gone.

running_deploys.description: Every deploy still moving, of every project and environment, newest first (`deploys` has the selected environment's only).

secrets.description: Open first, then the latest 20 resolved.

skipped_problems.description: The warning codes the person skipped for now (`problem::skip`) in the selected environment, sorted.

skipped_values.description: The names the person skipped for now (`values::skip`) in the selected environment, sorted.
